The code review has been written to `.sdlc/runs/20261106-120000-feature-new-drawing-pages/review.json` (`verdict: "needs_changes"`).

### Root Causes & Findings Summary

1. **Single-page PRNG (`seed`/`versionNonce`) & 13 `"number of renders"` snapshot regressions**
   - **`packages/element/src/Scene.ts:207` (`setActivePageId`) & `packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx:3860` (`initializeScene`)**: `Scene.setActivePageId` does not early-return when `this.activePageId === pageId` and calls `this.triggerUpdate()` (line 418: `this.sceneNonce = randomInteger()`), while `App.initializeScene` (and `resetScene` at line 3720 / `loadFileToCanvas` at line 11169) calls `this.scene.setActivePageId(...)` without `{ triggerUpdate: false }` right before `syncActionResult` / `replaceAllElements`. On every default single-page `<Excalidraw />` mount, this extra `triggerUpdate()` consumes one extra PRNG value from `reseed(7)` and fires an extra render before any user interaction, shifting all subsequent element `seed` and `versionNonce` values across `contextmenu`, `dragCreate`, `move`, `multiPointCreate`, `regressionTests`, and `selection`, and causing the 13 `"number of renders"` snapshot failures.

2. **Per-page undo history defect (`AC-4: isolates undo history per page`)**
   - **`packages/excalidraw/components/App.tsx:2804` (`activatePage`), `App.tsx:5177` (`updateScene`), and `packages/excalidraw/history.ts:139,242`**:
     - `activatePage` calls `this.scene.setActivePageId(pageId)` before committing pending micro-actions on the outgoing page, and then schedules a `CaptureUpdateAction.NEVER` micro-action against `this.store.snapshot` (whose `elements` map still holds the previous page's elements, causing `StoreSnapshot.maybeClone` to mark previous-page elements as `{ isDeleted: true, version: prev.version + 1 }`).
     - `updateScene` schedules `this.store.scheduleMicroAction` before applying `appState.activePageId` and without normalizing `elements` via `withElementPageId(el, activePageId)`, leaving `pageId: undefined` in `StoreSnapshot` while `Scene.replaceAllElements` assigns `pageId`.
     - `History.perform` diffs active-page `nextElements` against `this.store.snapshot` without scoping `prevSnapshot` to `this.activePageId`.
   - **`packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx:6,23,35,195`**:
     - Renders `<Excalidraw />` without `handleKeyboardGlobally={true}`, so `Keyboard.keyPress(KEYS.Z)` in `undo()` and `Keyboard.keyPress(KEYS.A)` in `AC-1` dispatch `keydown` on `document` and never reach `App.onKeyDown`.
     - Calls `h.app.addPage`, `h.app.switchPage`, `h.app.renamePage`, `h.app.reorderPages`, `h.app.deletePage`, and `h.setState` outside `act(...)`.
     - Imports non-exported `exportToSvg` instead of `exportScene` from `../scene/export` (`TS2459` at line 6) and has 2 Prettier formatting warnings at lines 195–196.

### Passing Checks
- `excalidraw-app/tests/pagesCollabAndStorage.test.tsx`: all collaboration, reconciliation, local storage, and export-to-backend tests pass.
- Backward-compatible single-page default state (`pages: [{ id: "page-1", name: "Page 1" }]`, `activePageId: "page-1"`, `pageViewports: {}`) and multi-page restore (`restore.ts`) match `change_plan.md`.
